project.name: Thoth Module Byzantine Fault Tolerance Remediation
project.description: Fix critical gaps between design intent and implementation in Byzantine fault tolerance, cryptographic validation, metrics, and resource management
project.business_impact: DHT operations vulnerable to Byzantine attacks due to missing validation integration and detection infrastructure

critical_issues.title: Byzantine Detection Infrastructure Unused
critical_issues.description: ThothByzantineStateProvider is implemented but never instantiated. Byzantine fault detection framework exists but is not integrated into DHT operations.
critical_issues.impact: System cannot detect Byzantine behavior from colliding nodes

critical_issues.title: No Cryptographic Validation in Quorum Operations
critical_issues.description: Quorum-based store and retrieve operations do not validate signatures. Byzantine nodes can provide invalid data accepted by majority.
critical_issues.impact: Corrupted KERLs can be accepted due to lack of cryptographic verification

critical_issues.title: Validation Components Not Integrated
critical_issues.description: Ani (KERI validation) and Maat (witnessing) components exist but are not integrated into DHT quorum operations. No validation hooks in store/retrieve flows.
critical_issues.impact: DHT operations bypass all validation, defeating KERI security model

critical_issues.title: Metrics Interface Completely Empty
critical_issues.description: KerlDhtMetrics and GorgoneionMetrics interfaces define empty stub methods. No operational observability for DHT health or Byzantine detection.
critical_issues.impact: Cannot monitor DHT health, Byzantine behavior, or performance in production

significant_issues.title: Multisig Support Incomplete
significant_issues.description: Threshold-based quorum voting not fully implemented. Some paths use simple majority, others use 3f+1.

significant_issues.title: Error Handling Inconsistencies
significant_issues.description: Different error handling approaches across modules. Some fail fast, others retry indefinitely.
significant_issues.impact: Difficult to debug failures, cascading timeouts

significant_issues.title: Resource Management Minimal
significant_issues.description: Thread pools not configured, memory cleanup hooks missing, connections not bounded. No lifecycle management.
significant_issues.impact: Memory leaks, thread exhaustion in production

significant_issues.title: No Fork Attack Detection
significant_issues.description: DHT can accept different event sequences from different paths. No detection of conflicting KERLs.

phases.name: Core Enhancement & Hardening
phases.description: Complete multisig support, standardize error handling, improve resource management, add fork attack detection and recovery

Unified error handling framework with retry policies and circuit breakers
Resource management: bounded thread pools, memory cleanup, connection pooling
Fork attack detection and automatic recovery procedures

phases.name: Integration & Scalability Testing
phases.description: Comprehensive testing with Fireflies membership, CHOAM state machines, chaos engineering, large-scale scenarios, and production deployment
key_deliverables: Full integration tests with Fireflies and CHOAM (10+ scenarios)
Chaos engineering tests (network partitions, Byzantine nodes, cascading failures)
Scalability tests with 10-100+ nodes and 1M+ identifiers
SLA validation (latency p95, throughput, Byzantine detection window)
Deployment and operational guides with runbooks

critical_fixes: ThothByzantineStateProvider instantiated and active in all DHT operations

No critical or high-severity code quality issues
Performance SLAs met: p95 latency <=100ms, throughput >=10K ops/sec
integration: Successfully integrates with Fireflies membership service
Works with CHOAM state machines for replicated applications
Compatible with Stereotomy for KERI operations
gRPC service contracts stable and well-documented

key_components.name: KerlDHT
key_components.description: Core DHT implementation with Byzantine fault tolerance and gossip-based rebalancing
key_components.responsibility: Distributed storage and routing of KERLs based on identifier digest

key_components.name: Ani
key_components.description: KERI event validation service supporting root and KERL set validation
key_components.responsibility: Cryptographic validation of key events and KERL integrity

key_components.name: Maat
key_components.description: Byzantine fault-tolerant witnessing and certification service
key_components.responsibility: Witness coordination and consensus for event validity

key_components.name: ThothByzantineStateProvider
key_components.description: Byzantine detection infrastructure for state validation
key_components.responsibility: Detect and respond to Byzantine behavior

key_components.name: KerlDhtMetrics
key_components.responsibility: Track DHT performance, Byzantine detection, and errors

key_components.name: DhtService
key_components.responsibility: Network interface for DHT client requests

key_components.name: ReconciliationService
key_components.description: Data consistency service for DHT rebalancing during membership changes
key_components.responsibility: Gossip protocol implementation for KERL migration
